character.name: Idle
character.prompt: Ollphéist, a great Celtic serpent-wyrm from Irish myth. A massive legless coiling serpent with dark bronze-green scales and a pale cream underbelly, its sinuous body curled into an S-shape. A pair of curling ram-like horns sweep back from its head, glowing amber eyes, and a fanged open maw. Subtle Celtic knotwork patterning runs along its scales, with a faint spined ridge down its back. Ancient, menacing water serpent — no legs, no wings.
